scientific_question: On a genuinely fresh system, do unchanged EOG Layer-B features add heldout value to the same already-strong external learner under the paired complementarity contract?

registry_source.role: response-independent camera SiteID and operation-date registry

response_source.published_semantics: 1 if wildebeest were present and 0 if absent during DAYS.ON for each 4-day NDVI.BIN

node_universe.rule: unique camera SiteIDs in frozen search_effort.csv

geometry.construction: derive fixed analysis-grid coordinates solely from SiteID: letter B..V is grid x and integer 1..13 is grid y; Euclidean distance is measured in grid-index units
geometry.why_response_blind: the published camera array was a predetermined regular grid; no X_coord/Y_coord value from the 2011-2018 occupancy response tables is read for world construction

prospective_estimability.reason: published data description establishes eight years of 4-day occupancy but does not publish endpoint-matched frozen 0->1/0->0 counts for the future split; exact count gate remains mandatory before fitting

no_rescue: do not read wildebeest/zebra/gazelle response values to choose geometry or structural thresholds
do not use response-table X_coord/Y_coord to rescue a failed SiteID-grid gate
do not change the focal species after opening response
do not weaken the paired same-learner complementarity endpoint after response
